home_tagline: Get help, or give help. No account needed.
hero_document_sub: Photos, notes, audio. Stays on your phone.
card_stay_safe_sub: Crisis steps, rights, notices. Works offline.
card_directory_sub: Checked orgs and resources, by city.
no_state_helpline: State emergency numbers reach the police.
no_state_helpline_2: This app does not carry one.
gv_food: Food, water, shelter, charging, a ride
opens_after_checks: This part opens after safety checks finish.
works_now: The Stay safe pages and the Directory work now.
staysafe_pending: Safety steps are being reviewed by a medic and a lawyer.
notices_what: Official notices appear here, signed by our team.
notices_stale: Showing your last saved copy. It may be out of date.
notice_directive_warning: Unverified directive. Do not act on this without checking it yourself.
notice_unverified: Not verified on this device yet.
verify_channel_domain: The only official web address is:
verify_channel_pending: Key fingerprints will be published after our signing setup is complete. Until then, treat notices as not verified.
canary_ok: Confirmed. No secret legal demand as of the signed date.
canary_unconfirmed: Not confirmed right now. The signal is missing or out of date. Take extra care with notices.
canary_pending: Not set up yet. It starts after our signing setup is complete.
share_intro: Send the signed safety content to another phone with no internet. The other phone checks the signature before it trusts the content.
share_import_ok: Verified. This content is signed by our team.
share_import_unverified: Not verified. This copy is not signed by our team. Do not trust it.
share_import_bad: This is not a Harborage content file.
document_keep: Documents stay on your phone until you send them.
document_location_note: Exact location is removed from every document.
nearby_how: Updates are delayed and cover whole areas, never exact spots.
directory_empty: The directory is being checked. Entries appear after review.
set_identity_1: Your account is made on this phone.
set_identity_2: There is no name, phone number, or email.
set_identity_3: Write down the backup words when they appear.
set_identity_4: If you lose the backup words, you lose the account.
set_identity_5: No one can reset it. That is what keeps it safe.
ident_none_1: You can read everything without an account.
ident_none_2: You need one to send, or to offer help.
ident_fingerprint_hint: Use this to check two phones hold the same account.
ident_tier_full: This phone can hold your account.
ident_tier_basic: This phone holds your account an older way. It still works.
ident_tier_readonly: This phone cannot hold an account.
ident_tier_readonly_hint: You can read everything. You cannot send.
ident_words_2: Keep the paper where only you can reach it.
ident_words_3: Anyone with these words can use your account.
ident_confirm_bad: Those words do not match. Look at your paper and try again.
ident_keep_label: Keep the backup words on this phone
ident_keep_hint: Easier if you cannot write them down. Anyone who unlocks this phone can read them.
ident_keep_gone: The words are not on this phone. Put them back in to turn this on.
ident_restore_hint: Type all 12 words in order. Put a space between them.
ident_restore_bad: Those are not valid backup words. Check the spelling.
ident_wipe_warn: This deletes the account from this phone. Only your backup words bring it back.
ident_wipe_go: Remove it. I have my backup words.
ident_storage_error: This phone would not save the account. Check storage space, then try again.
set_safe_1: Close, at the top, opens the Directory and clears your screen.
set_safe_2: The app looks plain on purpose.
set_safe_3: This app does not send notifications.
wipe_title: Erase what is on this phone
wipe_intro: This removes everything this app saved here.
wipe_1: Every document you saved here goes.
wipe_2: Photos, notes, audio, and saved pages go.
wipe_3: Anything still waiting to send goes.
wipe_4: A sealed original that never reached the vault is destroyed.
wipe_5: You cannot get any of it back.
wipe_limit_1: This does not clear your browser history.
wipe_also_account: Also remove the account from this phone
wipe_also_account_hint: Only your backup words bring it back.
wipe_words_here: Your backup words are saved here. They go too.
set_offline_2: Anything you send waits for signal. The app tells you.
label_team_meaning: Someone on our team confirmed this and its contact.
label_nearby_meaning: Local users marked this as real. Not team-confirmed. Use your judgement.
label_unchecked_meaning: No one has confirmed this. Be careful.
label_problem_meaning: People flagged this. It may be wrong or old. Check before you rely on it.
checking_intro: Every item shows one of four labels.
limits_intro: Read this before you rely on the app.
limits_1: Your network provider can see that you use this site.
limits_2: So can Cloudflare, the company that hosts it.
limits_3: If someone takes your unlocked phone, they can read what is on it.
limits_4: Saved documents stay on this phone only.
limits_5: A phone reset, seizure, or app wipe destroys them.
limits_6: We keep no name, number, or email. We cannot reset your account.
limits_6a: Your backup words are the only way back into your account.
limits_6b: If you keep them on this phone, anyone who unlocks it can read them.
limits_7: Photos and video you send stay sealed. We cannot read them.
limits_7a: What you write about an event, we can read.
limits_7b: It is meant to become part of the public record.
limits_7c: The note is sealed on the way to us. We can open it.
limits_8: Courts can still order companies to hand over traffic records.
limits_9: This app is served from the web.
limits_10: A forced, targeted change to it could go unseen.
limits_11: The phone app version, when it comes, will be stronger.
limits_12: Photos here help preserve events. We cannot promise a court accepts them.
error_body: Check the address, or go back to Home.
document_new_sub: Photos, notes, or audio. Stays on your phone.
document_none: No documents on this phone yet.
turnstile_check: Quick check that you are a person
turnstile_failed: The check could not run here. Sending stays closed until it does.
turnstile_wait: Finish the check above, then send.
video_sealed_1: We cannot cover faces in a video on this phone.
video_sealed_2: The video is sealed. Only you can open it.
video_no_server_promise: We will not make a face-covered video for you later.
video_poster_intro: We can make one still picture from the video.
video_poster_cover: You cover the faces on that picture, like a photo.
video_poster_failed: This phone could not read the video well enough to make a still picture.
video_poster_failed_2: Nothing from the video is shared. It stays sealed and private.
verify_intro: Paste a record and its proof. This page checks it on your phone.
verify_offline_note: Nothing is sent anywhere. This page works with no network.
verify_not_anchored: Nothing outside our system has confirmed this root yet.
verify_bad_hash: This record does not match its own hash. It has been changed.
verify_bad_path: The proof does not reach the root given.
verify_malformed: This is not a record and proof we can read.
verify_preservation: This supports preservation for lawful processes. It is not a promise that a court accepts it.
outbox_stop_note: Sending stops. The document stays on this phone.
outbox_needs_you: Open this and finish the check to send it.
outbox_step_vaulted: The original is in the vault.
outbox_stopped_trying: Sending stopped. The original is still only on this phone.
outbox_on_device_only: The original is only on this phone.
outbox_lost: The original is gone from this phone. It never reached the vault.
outbox_storage_warn: This phone may drop the sealed original. Send it when you have signal.
outbox_storage_full: Space here is nearly full. The sealed original may be dropped.
document_stays: This stays on your phone until you send it.
document_video_note: We can't hide faces in video yet. Film carefully.
document_pick_photo_intro: Pick a photo from this phone.
redact_intro: Drag a solid box over each face, badge, or number plate.
redact_hint: Drag across a face to cover it.
redact_decode_failed: This photo could not open here. Keep it private, or pick another.
redact_confirm_q: Did you cover every face and ID?
redact_private_note: The photo stays on this phone. No public copy is made.
confirm_intro: This is the exact copy people would see. Nothing else is sent.
confirm_alt_after: The covered copy, as people would see it.
confirm_none_covered: You covered nothing in this photo. Send it only if no face or number plate shows.
confirm_send_ok: Yes, this is safe to share
confirm_note: Covering is permanent. The covered parts are gone from this copy.
redact_build_failed: We could not make a safe copy to share on this phone. Your photo stays private on this phone.
redact_cover_unverified: We checked the copy and could not confirm every box is solid. Your photo stays private on this phone.
audio_no_voice: Voices are not changed. The audio stays on this phone.
import_intro: Paste a link to a public post or clip. We save the link, not the video, for now.
describe_area_ph: City or area. No exact address.
saved_body: Your document is on this phone only.
err_generic: Something did not work. Try again.
err_mic: We could not use the microphone.
incidents_intro: Incidents people have documented. Each shows how it was checked.
incidents_not_open: The public record is not open yet.
directory_intro: Places and groups that help. Each shows how it was checked.
dir_report_thanks: Thanks. A person will check this.
card_draft_banner: Draft. Under legal and medical review. Do not rely on this yet.
